arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_type AS card_type, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id GROUP BY c.card_type ORDER BY c.card_type
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate for each card type over labelled transactions, with counts for context.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only (transactions with a fraud_labels row); unlabelled transactions are excluded.
Card type is taken from the card used on each transaction, with 'Debit (Prepaid)' kept as its own type separate from 'Debit'.
The full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is used, with no date filter.
